_comment: D-049. Two gates that emitted green signals through real holes. They move unchanged and are referenced by nothing; until BL-003 fixes them, the enforcement IS the deletion of every documented invocation. g-quarantine ships in BL-003. D-038 places them at repo-root quarantine/ rather than packages/**: each defines its own verdictOf and walked/checked pair, which D-005 forbids inside the live toolchain, and an exemption list inside g-coverage-single-impl would be the exact tampering pattern this rebuild removes.

holes: verdictOf has no zero-coverage rule: a formId that is empty, null or absent is never walked, giving walked 0 / checked 0 / verdict pass / exit 0 — the exact false green its own header claims to prevent
defines a second verdictOf and a second walked/checked counter pair, which D-005 permits in exactly one file
creates families lazily, so rewording two files moved 9 agent-dispatch pointers from checked 9 to unmentioned and the run still reported PASS
crashes with an uncaught SyntaxError on malformed JSON, which is indistinguishable by exit code from a real failure
defines its own walked/checked counter pair
a standalone argv script rather than a node:test file, and its path constants resolve relative to the skill folder it no longer lives in
CommonJS, and its only consumer is the T4b DOM residue probe that BL-005 owns; no Scope A code path reaches it
